raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fuse DeepSeek-V4.1 C1/C2 compression with RoPE, FP8 quantization and the 584-byte main-cache write. Integrate ordinary attention and the target model's KV-only bounded-prefill replay path on SM90.

**Draft with complete serving integration.** Measured operator speedup is **1.18–1.53x**. The completed H20 two-TP4 crossover shows a positive cold 16K/c4 signal, but **does not establish a stable general end-to-end gain**.

The fusion boundary is inspired by [SGLang #41660](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41660) by @DarkSharpness. This implementation retains vLLM's own FP32 pooling/RMSNorm and BF16 latent rounding.

## Claims

- Preserve the indexer's BF16 latent, ring-state ordering, distinct state/cache slots and padding semantics.
- Integrate both callers for CUDA SM90, uint8 584-byte cache, PCP1/DCP1. Other hardware, KV formats and context-parallel configurations retain separate insertion.
- No weight conversion, extra persistent weight/cache allocation, Humming backend change, scheduler change or model-runner change.
- Operator acceleration is measured; **model acceleration is not established**.

## Validation

H20-3e / SM90, torch 2.13.0+cu130, baseline vLLM 1ee69dde9, PR head 4fe427bd. The three original runtime files were also byte-identical to main 93d2cab35 when checked on 2026-10-11. GPU-tested candidate source hashes match this PR.

- **46 targeted full-module pytest cases passed**, 132 unrelated cases deselected. The existing reference test covers C1/C2 and fused/split modes; six consumption cases cover serial, auxiliary-stream and CUDA-Graph execution.
- **18 additional exact-byte cases passed** for state, latent and full cache contents: changed/restored graph inputs, ragged/empty/padded requests, ring wrap, negative cache slots, shrinking buffers, 128-request six-query verification and 16K prefill. No tolerance was relaxed.
- Full pre-commit passed on all four changed files, including Ruff, mypy and test tethering.

    .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/kernels/test_compressor_kv_cache.py \
      --confcutdir=tests/kernels \
      -k 'test_v41_fused_save_compress_and_insert or test_v41_attention_joins_cache_writes_before_consumption'

The confcutdir option excludes unrelated top-level model fixtures; it does not bypass these test bodies.

**Operator measurements:** each graph captures 128 complete operator chains, with one host launch per sample. After 20 calibration graphs, measure 50 alternating AB/BA pairs per shape. All 26 decode/verification/prefill shapes improve 1.18–1.53x. Reused buffers are L2-warm; this is not a model or HBM-saturation claim.

| Shape | Split µs | Fused µs | Speedup |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| C1, 16 requests × 6 queries | 3.406 | 2.266 | 1.503x |
| C2, 16 requests × 6 queries | 6.231 | 4.978 | 1.252x |
| C1, 16K prefill | 48.681 | 41.252 | 1.180x |
| C2, 16K prefill | 45.905 | 33.412 | 1.374x |

[All shape medians and exact harnesses](https://github.com/xijiaat/vllm/tree/9b8678843704c27453a25e80db11dc84bb8f8c0c/integration). The earlier host-launched protocol independently measured 1.19–1.49x; its full raw pairs remain in [the initial evidence](https://github.com/xijiaat/vllm/blob/16cd0e863250da9e7c25ebb7ebb55ac931718bdd/result.json).

**Completed two-TP4 full-model crossover:** DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP4/EP, DP1, MRV2, Humming dense/MoE, Engram CPU offload, APC on, 16K chunk and **real DSpark 5 acceptance**. Both arms use the same image/weights/precision/sampling, the existing #60613 sentinel fix and identical unmodified TileLang compile seeds. Only the PR runtime files differ.

Two TP4 instances use disjoint GPU groups, CPU sets and NUMA memory. Only one receives requests at a time, with unchanged peer request/token/draft counters verified. The second phase restarts both engines with GPU groups swapped and reverses the AB/BA order. Each arm/cell has three measured batches per placement, **six total**, following two excluded calibration pairs per placement. All **72 measured batches / 1,152 requests** completed. These are two engine startups per arm, not six independent restarts.

All six workloads generate **1,024 actual tokens** per request from fixed 4K/16K ledger prompts. Throughput includes the complete HTTP batch and tail drain; it is not pure-prefill or permanently saturated steady-state throughput. Cold requests all report exactly zero cache hits. Warm requests retain 64 residual tokens: observed hits are 99.609375% at 16K and 98.4375% at 4K, not literal 100%.

| Workload | Baseline output tok/s | Fused output tok/s | Pooled median change | Phase 0 | Swapped phase 1 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cold 16K / c16 — primary | 355.06 | 354.86 | -0.05% | -0.09% | +0.61% |
| Warm 16K / c16 | 846.13 | 839.59 | -0.77% | -2.09% | -0.15% |
| Cold 4K / c4 | 479.74 | 470.55 | -1.92% | -11.39% | +19.68% |
| Warm 4K / c4 | 562.92 | 520.78 | -7.49% | -15.63% | +9.45% |
| Cold 16K / c4 | 270.43 | 276.63 | +2.29% | +3.81% | +2.45% |
| Warm 16K / c4 | 526.67 | 531.65 | +0.95% | +8.60% | -14.68% |

Cold 16K/c4 is positive in both placements, but its pooled throughput CV is 7.04% / 5.12%, and real acceptance is also higher for B in both phases. This is a positive signal, not proof of a stable code-derived gain. The primary cold 16K/c16 CV is 1.92% / 1.70%; warm 16K/c16 is lower in both phases. Other low-concurrency cells reverse direction. No samples or unfavorable cells were dropped, and throughput was not adjusted by acceptance.

Runtime inventories confirm four affected producers per rank: C2 at layers 2/8/14 and C1 at layer 20, with the expected branch in every rank. This limits the whole-model opportunity. [All batch samples, medians, ranges/CV, TTFT, TPOT, actual acceptance, source hashes and reproduction scripts](https://github.com/xijiaat/vllm/blob/9fe3daffb76889a0fc996b42961fb02b6dd3cb16/dual-tp4/REPORT.txt). The report also includes a separate geometric placement estimate; it is not substituted for the pooled-median ratio above.

<details>
<summary>Earlier single-engine sequential cohort — retained separately</summary>

**Initial full-model A/B:** same ordered four H20 GPUs, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP4/EP, DP1, MRV2, Humming dense/MoE, Engram CPU offload, APC on and **real DSpark 5 acceptance**. Both arms share the existing #60613 sentinel fix and identical unmodified TileLang compile seeds. Weights, precision, inputs, sampling and cache protocol are unchanged.

One sequential A/B pair. Each cell has two excluded calibration samples and **three measured samples**, each sending twice the concurrency through continuous refill workers. Warm cells generate 1024 tokens; cold controls generate one token with verified zero cache hits. Warm requests retain 64 residual prompt tokens: observed hit ratios are 99.609375% at 16K and 98.4375% at 4K, **not literal 100%**.

| Workload | Baseline tok/s | Fused tok/s | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Warm 16K / c16, output — primary | 836.11 | 837.23 | +0.13% |
| Warm 4K / c4, output | 570.55 | 559.84 | −1.88% |
| Warm 16K / c4, output | 556.11 | 524.30 | −5.72% |
| Cold 4K / c4, input | 8874.16 | 8871.57 | −0.03% |
| Cold 16K / c4, input | 9464.59 | 9463.22 | −0.01% |

Primary throughput CV is 1.76% / 3.90%, larger than +0.13%. Low-concurrency decode CV is 7.14–12.98%, and acceptance varies between samples. Primary median server-mean TTFT is 463.44 / 478.96 ms, TPOT 15.823 / 15.841 ms, and mean acceptance length 3.997 / 4.099. The candidate's 1.089 s TTFT outlier is retained. This pair establishes neither a stable gain nor a causal regression.

Runtime inventories confirm four affected producers per rank: C2 at layers 2/8/14, C1 at layer 20, with the expected branch in both arms. This limited producer count constrains the whole-model opportunity.

This earlier cohort is not pooled with the crossover above.
</details>

**Regression and memory:** fixed first 128 GSM8K test questions, five-shot, natural EOS, maximum 1024 tokens. An explicit-final-number extractor frozen before B gives **123/128 baseline, 124/128 candidate**, with 125 parsed per arm, 122 matching numeric answers and 46 identical response messages. Neither arm truncated a response. Original hash-marker-only scores (20/17) are retained; that extractor misses boxed answers. This subset establishes neither full-model accuracy nor an accuracy improvement. Allocated/reserved memory after model load is identical on all ranks: 79,796,461,056 / 80,065,069,056 bytes. The crossover readiness snapshots were 119,175 MiB/GPU for A and 119,177 MiB/GPU for B (+2 MiB), identical in both placements. These snapshots are not peak VRAM.

[All measured samples, acceptance, latency, hashes, failure summary and reproduction settings](https://github.com/xijiaat/vllm/blob/9b8678843704c27453a25e80db11dc84bb8f8c0c/model/REPORT.txt). Exact benchmark and analysis scripts are in the same directory. New device-batched/model raw archives are retained on the test host with SHA256 records; they are not represented as uploaded raw data in this evidence branch.

## Details

fused_save_compress_norm gains optional RoPE/cache arguments. It shares the original 584-byte store implementation with the separate insertion kernel and explicitly preserves BF16 store/reload rounding. Ring-state slots and main-cache slots remain distinct.

Q/SWA preparation still overlaps compression. Fused compression publishes both latent and main cache before the existing join; indexer preparation then consumes that latent. This removes the second insertion fork/join but can delay indexer start, so kernel gains need not translate into model gains. KV-only bounded-prefill replay also avoids duplicate insertion. The separate DSpark drafter does not own C1/C2 compressors.

**Remaining before Ready:** NCU/causal profiling, convincing repeatable model benefit, and human review. H20 counter access requires additional permission that remains pending; no capabilities or host settings were changed. Other SM90 products have not been benchmarked.

Earlier harness attempts failed before any timed samples: an incorrect draft-inventory assertion, an unavailable cache-reset endpoint, an omitted dataset manifest, and a GPU UUID metadata-prefix mismatch in the initial crossover attempt. All are archived. The crossover launcher was interrupted by the bastion idle timeout after its independent phase-0 client completed; a detached controller verified ownership and resumed only phase 1 under the original time bound, without repeating or removing samples. All six crossover containers exited 0, and all eight test GPUs were verified at 0 MiB / 0% with no compute processes.

Duplicate-work checks for the compressor/fusion area and exact fused_save_compress_norm / rope_quant_insert symbols found no equivalent CUDA producer/cache fusion PR. Adjacent #56935/#57523 concern attention/KV formats, while #57977 concerns MXFP8 activation chaining. This is a bounded public search, not a claim about private work.

AI assistance was used to implement and validate this change with Codex. Human line review remains pending; please keep this as Draft.
